messages:
deploy-bot: kickoff: release/2025.09.03 - toggling feature flag `llm-adapt_v2` -> canary. pinned binary=v2.5.0. change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. cc @ada @rico for ramp.

ada: ack. proposed ramp: 1% -> 8% -> 25% -> 100%. soak: 10m, 15m, 20m. gates = 5xx < 0.3% && p95_delta < +90ms && synthetic-quality pass. manual hold at each step.

rico: uploading release notes + rollback snippet. rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback-flag llm-adapt_v2 && deploy-bot pin-service v2.4.7`. added relnotes link: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/2025-09-03-llmadapt.

hazel: add auto-mute: if p95_delta > +120ms for 6m OR 5xx > 0.6% for 3m -> auto-disable flag and notify incident channel. ops, please set OOM alert.

ops-oncall: alerts set for p95, 5xx, OOM, and router retries. reserving 6 canary hosts.

ada: deploy-bot, run dry-run health-check then start canary. tag `canary: ada-0903`

deploy-bot: dry-run ok. starting canary. logs:
```
[2025-09-03T01:05:12Z] build ok
[2025-09-03T01:06:40Z] deploy to canary (hosts=6)
[2025-09-03T01:08:00Z] flag llm-adapt_v2 set to 1% (cohort=canary)
```

ada: canary live. beginning 10m soak. monitors: @ops-oncall @hazel @rico

[6m into soak]
ops-oncall: brief p95 blip +110ms on host-03 for ~90s, no errors. looks like model-load jitter.

rico: request a `model-warm` on host-03 and re-evaluate. also note in relnotes.

ops-oncall: model-warm executed, host-03 stabilized. p95 trending down.

hazel: since blip was short and no error increase, continue soak then promote.

ada: promoting to 8% after completing soak.

deploy-bot: flag set to 8%. quality-check job started (n=50 every 5m).

[post promotion]
ada: at 8% we see small router retries spike but 5xx still under gate. holding full 15m soak.

[10m later]
ops-oncall: noticed increased cache-thrashing on edge cache leading to timeouts for a minority of requests (router 504). increased cache TTL and cleared stale entries. 5xx dropped back.

ada: good mitigation. keep hold for extra 10m to be safe. if 5xx exceeds 0.5% for 5m we execute rollback.

hazel: also enabled synthetic-quality sampling. current failure rate 0.9% (ok).

[after hold]
rico: metrics steady. proceeding to 25% then final ramp. documenting the cache fix in relnotes and playbook.

ops-oncall: final note: pin-back command and exact timestamps added to relnotes. if anything flips auto-mute, we'll follow manual rollback flow and post incident summary.

ada: thanks team. follow-ups: @rico update relnotes with freeze/rebalance step; @hazel keep synthetic checks running for 24h. end thread.
